title: VrowserManifest
description: Manifest file for vrowser virtual filesystem setup. Defines the mapping from virtual FS paths to actual source file paths. Generated by `gen:manifest` CLI or automatically by the `Vrowser()` plugin with `auto: true`.

name.description: Display name for the project. Defaults to package.json 'name' field.

files.description: Source files shown in the editor and loaded into the virtual FS. Keys are virtual FS paths (e.g. '/index.html'), values are actual file paths relative to the manifest file (path-reference mode) or file contents (content-resolved mode).

nodeModules.description: Node modules files loaded into the virtual FS under /node_modules/. Not shown in the editor. Keys are virtual FS paths (e.g. '/node_modules/vue/package.json'), values are actual file paths relative to the manifest file. CJS packages are auto-bundled to ESM under /node_modules/.vrowser-esm/.

vendor.description: Pre-bundled vendor/runtime files (legacy). Superseded by nodeModules for new projects.

activeFile.description: Default file to open in the editor. Must be a key from the 'files' object. Auto-detected from common patterns (App.vue, App.tsx, main.ts, index.html).
